[[Template:WindowsOnly]]

If you leave Firefox open when Windows shuts down, Firefox may automatically re-open with your previously opened tabs the next time you start Windows. Here's how to disable the feature.

=Prevent Firefox from starting automatically=
[[Template:aboutconfigwarning]]
# [[Template:aboutconfig]]
# Search for {pref toolkit.winRegisterApplicationRestart}.
#Click the ''Toggle'' [[Image:Fx71aboutconfig-ToggleButton]] button next to it, to set its value to {pref false}.
There's no need to restart Firefox; the changes take effect immediately.
